package orchestrator

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/godinj/drem-orchestrator/internal/model"
	"github.com/godinj/drem-orchestrator/internal/worktree"
)

func TestReconcileFailedParents_AllSubtasksDone(t *testing.T) {
	orch, db, _ := setupReconcileTest(t)

	parentID := uuid.New()
	parent := model.Task{
		ID:          parentID,
		ProjectID:   orch.projectID,
		Title:       "failed-parent-all-done",
		Description: "parent failed due to merge conflict, but all subtasks eventually completed",
		Status:      model.StatusFailed,
	}
	db.Create(&parent)

	// Three DONE subtasks — mirrors the real bug scenario (3/3 done, parent stuck failed).
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		sub := model.Task{
			ID:           uuid.New(),
			ProjectID:    orch.projectID,
			ParentTaskID: &parentID,
			Title:        "done-sub",
			Description:  "completed subtask",
			Status:       model.StatusDone,
		}
		db.Create(&sub)
	}

	n, err := orch.reconcileFailedParents()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("reconcileFailedParents() error: %v", err)
	}
	if n != 1 {
		t.Errorf("expected 1 parent recovered, got %d", n)
	}

	// Parent should no longer be failed — it transitions to in_progress first,
	// then checkFeatureCompletion decides the final status.
	var updated model.Task
	db.First(&updated, "id = ?", parentID)
	if updated.Status == model.StatusFailed {
		t.Errorf("parent should have been recovered from failed, still %s", updated.Status)
	}
}

func TestReconcileFailedParents_SubtasksNotAllDone(t *testing.T) {
	orch, db, _ := setupReconcileTest(t)

	parentID := uuid.New()
	parent := model.Task{
		ID:          parentID,
		ProjectID:   orch.projectID,
		Title:       "failed-parent-mixed",
		Description: "parent failed, subtasks still in mixed statuses",
		Status:      model.StatusFailed,
	}
	db.Create(&parent)

	// One DONE, one still IN_PROGRESS — 
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		status := model.StatusDone
		if i == 0 {
			status = model.StatusInProgress
		}
		sub := model.Task{
			ID:           uuid.New(),
			ProjectID:    orch.projectID,
			ParentTaskID: &parentID,
			Title:        "subtask",
			Description:  "subtask description",
			Status:       status,
		}
		db.Create(&sub)
	}

	n, err := orch.reconcileFailedParents()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("reconcileFailedParents() error: %v", err)
	}
	if n != 0 {
		t.Errorf("expected 0 parents recovered, got %d", n)
	}

	var updated model.Task
	db.First(&updated, "id = ?", parentID)
	if updated.Status != model.StatusFailed {
		t.Errorf("parent should still be failed, got %s", updated.Status)
	}
}

func TestReconcileFailedParents_ConstraintGateExhausted_NoNewCommits(t *testing.T) {
	orch, db, bareRepo := setupReconcileTest(t)

	branchName := "feature/test-exhausted"
	featureDir, err := orch.worktree.CreateFeatureWorktree(branchName)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to create feature worktree: %v", err)
	}

	// Get HEAD SHA
	shaOutput, err := worktree.RunGit([]string{"rev-parse", "HEAD"}, featureDir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to get HEAD SHA: %v", err)
	}
	headSHA := ""
	for _, line := range shaOutput {
		if line != "" {
			headSHA = line
			break
		}
	}

	parentID := uuid.New()
	parent := model.Task{
		ID:             parentID,
		ProjectID:       orch.projectID,
		Title:          "exhausted-parent",
		Status:         model.StatusFailed,
		WorktreeBranch: branchName,
		Context: map[string]any{
			"constraint_gate_exhausted":        true,
			"constraint_gate_failed_at_commit": headSHA,
		},
	}
	db.Create(&parent)

	// Create all subtasks as DONE.
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		sub := model.Task{
			ID:           uuid.New(),
			ProjectID:    orch.projectID,
			ParentTaskID: &parentID,
			Title:        "subtask",
			Status:       model.StatusDone,
		}
		db.Create(&sub)
	}

	n, err := orch.reconcileFailedParents()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("reconcileFailedParents() error: %v", err)
	}
	if n != 0 {
		t.Errorf("expected 0 parents recovered due to exhaustion, got %d", n)
	}

	var updated model.Task
	db.First(&updated, "id = ?", parentID)
	if updated.Status != model.StatusFailed {
		t.Errorf("parent should remain FAILED, got %s", updated.Status)
	}
}
